inline.message: Direct string interpolation of the column name into the SQL query allows SQL injection and can cause runtime errors if an invalid column is passed.
inline.suggested_fix: Validate the column against an allowlist of known column names or use parameterized queries for identifiers, e.g., check column in ('id','name','email') before constructing the query.

inline.message: Directly interpolating the column name into the SQL query allows SQL injection via ORDER BY clause.
inline.suggested_fix: Validate 'column' against an allowlist of known column names or construct the query using safe identifiers instead of f-string interpolation.
